title: Signal Set
description: Every piece of feedback from every source, normalised to one record shape. Stage 1 output. Signal IDs are the evidence spine of the run - Stage 4 cites them and Stage 5 checks they exist.

generated.description: ISO timestamp of the ingest run

label.description: How the practitioner refers to it, e.g. 'Training eval - wave 2'

document.description: Path of the file it was ingested from

population.description: People invited/eligible. Needed to state a response rate honestly.

wave.description: Label for trend comparison, e.g. 'W1', 'W2'. Same wave label = same measurement round.

dimension.description: Readiness dimension. See reference/readiness-dimensions.md - the mapping is set in the source adapter, never guessed per row.

question.description: The instrument's own wording, not a paraphrase

value.description: quant only - raw response on the stated scale

reverse.description: true when a high raw score is bad news

text.description: verbatim only - the respondent's own words, unedited

segment.description: Free-form segment attributes from the source, e.g. {group, site, role}. 'group' is the default rollup key.

respondent_ref.description: Source-local respondent identifier. Never a name or an email.
